title: Height of an expression
statement: For expressions built from natural-number constants and variables using binary addition, subtraction, and multiplication, and unary loads, define the height $h$ recursively by $h(c)=h(x)=1$ for a constant $c$ or variable $x$, $h(	ext{op}(a,b))=\max(h(a),h(b)+1)$ for a binary operation with operands $a,b$, and $h(\text{load}(a))=h(a)$.
